h1: Land Rover Cylinder Head Repair & Rebuild

blocks.html: A Land Rover cylinder head repair is a precision engineering job that addresses warping, cracking, valve seat wear, and oil leakage. It can be carried out as a **standalone top-end overhaul** or as part of a **full engine rebuild**.

items: **Cylinder head removal** — cooling system drained, manifolds removed, camshaft/rocker components stripped, head bolts loosened in reverse tightening sequence
**Full inspection** — dye-penetrant crack detection, pressure testing of coolant jackets, flatness measurement, valve guide and valve seat wear assessment
**Precision machining** — resurfacing / skimming to restore flatness, valve guide replacement, valve seat recutting, valve refacing
**Reassembly with new components** — new valve stem oil seals, new cylinder head gasket, new core plugs where required, new cylinder head bolts (single-use where applicable)
**Testing** — compression test, cooling system pressure test, road test after refit

blocks.html: Every cylinder head we repair is pressure-tested after machining to verify coolant jacket integrity before it goes back on the engine.

steps.title: Preparation & Removal
steps.body: Cooling system drained, oil drained, intake/exhaust manifolds removed, rocker shaft / camshaft components stripped, injectors and glow plugs removed, cylinder head bolts loosened in reverse tightening sequence, head lifted from block.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.body: Cylinder head inspected for cracks using dye-penetrant testing, pressure-tested for coolant jacket integrity, flatness checked with precision straight-edge and feeler gauges.

steps.title: Machining
steps.body: Cylinder head resurfaced / skimmed where required, valve guides inspected and replaced where necessary, valve seats recut, valves refaced, valve stem oil seals replaced, core plugs checked and replaced where required.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: Valves installed with new valve stem seals, springs and retainers fitted, new cylinder head gasket fitted, cylinder head refitted and torqued to manufacturer specification using angle-torque procedure, rocker shaft / camshaft components refitted, injectors and glow plugs refitted.

steps.title: Testing & Final Check
steps.body: Engine started and run to operating temperature, cooling system pressure-tested for leaks, compression test performed, road test performed, final quality-control inspection.

items.q: What does a Land Rover cylinder head repair involve?
items.a: A cylinder head repair involves removing the cylinder head from the engine block, inspecting it for cracks and warping, pressure testing the coolant jacket, resurfacing the mating face, replacing valve guides and valve stem seals, recutting valve seats, refacing valves, then reassembling with a new cylinder head gasket and torquing to manufacturer specifications.

items.q: How much does a Land Rover cylinder head rebuild cost?
items.a: Cylinder head repair is typically quoted as part of a full engine rebuild. Full rebuild prices start from £1,900 for 4-cylinder diesel, £2,200 for 4-cylinder petrol, £2,400–£3,200 for 6-cylinder diesel, £4,500 for naturally aspirated V8, and £5,500 for supercharged V8. Standalone cylinder head repair is quoted individually. [See our pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

items.q: Which Land Rover models are affected by cylinder head issues?
items.a: Cylinder head issues can affect any Land Rover with high mileage or overheating history. Known patterns include Td5 injector and crank sensor wear, 200Tdi/300Tdi cylinder head cracking, TDV6/SDV6 timing chain and bearing issues, Ingenium diesel timing chain tensioner wear, and K-Series head gasket failure in Freelander 1.8i models. See the full list of models above.

items.q: Do you resurface / skim cylinder heads?
items.a: Yes. We machine-resurface cylinder heads to restore flatness after warping. Td5 cylinder heads require specific hardness testing before resurfacing. We pressure-test every cylinder head after machining to verify coolant jacket integrity.

items.q: Is cylinder head repair included in your engine rebuild service?
items.a: Yes, full cylinder head overhaul is a standard part of every engine rebuild we carry out — including crack testing, pressure testing, resurfacing, valve guides, valve stem seals, and new cylinder head gasket. We also offer standalone top-end overhauls where a full rebuild isn't required.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on cylinder head work?
items.a: Yes. Every engine rebuild and cylinder head repair we carry out comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour. [Read our full warranty terms →](/warranty)

items.q: How long does a cylinder head repair take?
items.a: Standalone cylinder head work typically takes 2-5 working days depending on the engine and machining requirements. If it's part of a full engine rebuild, the turnaround is 3-5 working days from arrival at the workshop.
